items.question: How tall is Kathryn Westbeld?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Kathryn Westbeld at 6 feet 3 inches.

items.question: Is Kathryn Westbeld related to Maddy Westbeld?
items.answer: Yes. Maddy Westbeld is Kathryn Westbeld's sister. She also played at Notre Dame and was drafted 16th overall by Chicago in the 2025 WNBA Draft.

items.question: Who has Kathryn Westbeld played for in the WNBA?
items.answer: Kathryn Westbeld played her first WNBA season in 2025 with the Phoenix Mercury, who signed her to a training camp contract on February 10, 2025. She went undrafted out of Notre Dame in 2018 and was waived by the Los Angeles Sparks in training camp that May.

items.question: Did Kathryn Westbeld win a national title at Notre Dame?
items.answer: Yes. Kathryn Westbeld helped Notre Dame win the 2018 NCAA championship and had a team-high nine rebounds in the title game against Mississippi State. She played 141 games for the Irish from 2014 to 2018.

items.question: Did Kathryn Westbeld play in Puerto Rico?
items.answer: Yes. Kathryn Westbeld played for Atenienses de Manatí in Puerto Rico from 2019 to 2021 and was the league's Forward of the Year in 2021. She has also played in Australia, Spain, France, Italy, Israel and Hungary.

items.question: Where is Kathryn Westbeld from?
items.answer: Kathryn Westbeld was born in Kettering, Ohio. Her WNBA bio says she is the daughter of Susan and Jim Westbeld and the third of five children.

items.question: What are Kathryn Westbeld's stats?
items.answer: In the 2025 regular season, Kathryn Westbeld averaged 5.1 points, 2.5 rebounds, and 0.9 assists in 43 games for the Phoenix Mercury.
